input.quote: (h) Neither Party may assign (voluntarily, by operation of law, or otherwise) this Agreement or any rights or obligations under this Agreement without the other Party's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld, provided however, that either Party may assign this Agreement without approval or consent to any affiliate or purchaser of all or substantially all of said Party's assets related to the subject matter of this Agreement or to any successor by way of merger, stock sale, consolidation or similar transaction.
input.rationale: Paragraph 8(h) is the only assignment provision. It already delivers most of our preferred position: AP may assign without consent to an affiliate, to a purchaser of substantially all relevant assets, or to a successor by merger/stock sale/consolidation, and other assignments require consent that cannot be unreasonably withheld. The termination provisions (4(a)-(b), p0016-p0017) contain no change-of-control termination or re-pricing right against AP, and no clause deems a change of control an assignment, so the walk-away risks are absent. The single gap is that the mutual carve-out lets Kubient assign the Agreement (including to an AP competitor) with no consent at all. Because the mutual carve-out is a reasonable existing bargain we also benefit from, we take the fallback approach and add only a narrow prohibition on Kubient assigning to an AP competitor without our consent, rather than subjecting all Vendor assignments to consent.

proposal.summary: Bar Kubient from assigning to an AP competitor without consent, preserving the mutual affiliate/successor carve-out
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We are comfortable with the mutual affiliate/successor carve-out, but our playbook does not permit the Vendor to assign this Agreement to one of our competitors without our consent, so we have added that limited exception. All other assignment mechanics, including our own right to assign in a merger or sale of assets, are unchanged.

ops.oldText: or to any successor by way of merger, stock sale, consolidation or similar transaction.
ops.newText: or to any successor by way of merger, stock sale, consolidation or similar transaction, provided further that Kubient may not assign this Agreement or any rights or obligations under it to a competitor of Customer without Customer's prior written consent.
